releaseNotes:
- FULL Urdu translation: every screen is now translated - no more mixed English/Urdu
- Language chooser in Profile > Preferences: tap Language, pick English or Urdu (current one is marked)
- Update dialogs no longer overflow - text scrolls, buttons never overlap
- SOS snooze indicator is now clearly visible in both light and dark theme
- SOS vibration buzz and alert sound on sender and volunteer side
- Update downloads show real progress and pick a package matching your phone
